headline: PM Modi Criticises Opposition Over Reservation Policies On Constitution Day
seoTitle: PM Modi Criticises Opposition On Constitution Day
metaDescription: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed Constitution Day, accusing the opposition of plotting to redistribute OBC reservation quotas to Muslims.
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi commemorated Constitution Day while accusing opposition parties of attempting to reduce OBC quotas.
The Prime Minister alleged that the Congress party and its allies intend to divert reservation benefits toward minority communities.
Simultaneously, opposition groups, including the Congress and Samajwadi Party, announced nationwide protests targeting the Election Commission.
aiContextParagraph: Constitution Day, celebrated annually on November 26, commemorates the adoption of the Indian Constitution by the Constituent Assembly in 1949. During this year's observation, Prime Minister Narendra Modi engaged in a political debate, describing the document as a vital component of the nation's democratic heritage. He directed criticism at the Congress party and its political allies, characterizing them as power-hungry. The Prime Minister specifically alleged that these opposition groups aim to decrease the existing quota allocated to Other Backward Classes to provide those benefits to Muslims. In a separate development occurring on the same day, opposition parties like the Congress and the Samajwadi Party declared plans for nationwide demonstrations against the Election Commission of India. These events highlight the ongoing tensions regarding social reservation policies and electoral administration as the country marks this historic constitutional milestone.
whyItIsViral: The story is widely covered by three major independent news outlets with rapid reporting velocity, driven by a direct confrontation between the Prime Minister and opposition leaders.
